title: Auto Loans: Payment Extensions
content:
A payment extension on an Auto Loans account moves one installment, or up to the product's per-extension maximum of installments, to the end of the loan. It changes the borrower's contract terms, so it rests on the borrower's own agreement.

## The borrower's agreement

The agent registers a payment extension request on the loan, which stands awaiting the borrower's confirmation, and the extension is granted only when the borrower has signed. The signature is the borrower's own act; the request record shows whether it is still awaiting it.

## Eligibility, read from the bank's records on the day of granting

| Test | What must be true |
|---|---|
| Status and arrears | the loan is active, or delinquent by no more than the product's most days past due for an extension |
| Loan seasoning | the loan funded at least the product's required number of whole months earlier |
| Payment history | at least the product's required number of scheduled installments have been fully satisfied since funding |
| Recent frequency | extensions granted on the loan in the rolling 365 days ending today number fewer than the product's yearly allowance |
| Lifetime use | extensions used over the loan's life number fewer than the product's lifetime allowance |

**Counting seasoning.** Months are calendar months counted from the funding date; the extension is allowed on the day that is the funding date moved forward by the required number of months, and on any later day. That day itself qualifies.

**Counting history and frequency.** Installments count as satisfied when scheduled payments credited toward their due dates reached the monthly payment; each distinct due date counts once. Recent extensions are counted from the extension fees booked on the loan in the rolling 365 days.

## What a granted extension does

- The next payment due date and the maturity date both move forward by the number of installments deferred.
- Interest continues to accrue daily on principal throughout.
- Any late charges still unpaid remain due.
- The product's extension fee is charged as an extension fee on the loan.
- An extension does not by itself make a delinquent loan current, unless the installments it defers are exactly the ones past due.

Requests for longer deferrals, for a lower rate or for forgiveness of principal fall outside this policy.

## Where the seasoning line falls (abstract dates)

For a loan funded on the 20th of a month and a requirement of M months, the 20th of the month M months later is the first qualifying day; the 19th of that month is one day short.
